newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Inmins says to restructure unit's debt.
newsitem.headline: Inmins says to restructure unit's debt.

text.p: Inmins Ltd said on Tuesday that it has resolved to restructure various types of commercial debt, worth around 33 million rand, in on of its subsidiary.

It said it had entered into talks on the restructure with a consortium of banks comparising Standard Bank of South Africa Ltd, First National Bank Holdings Ltd, ABSA Bank Ltd and UAL Merchant Bank Ltd.
Agreement had been reached in principle with these banks and a written agreement was being drawn up.
Shareholders in Inmins Ltd, Winbel Ltd and Winhold Ltd were advised to exercise caution in their sharedealings as the restructure may affect their share prices.
